checked_profile.summary: A marketplace that routes student refinance applications to its lender network.
checked_profile.scope: This check covers Splash’s marketplace and application disclosures. Loan amounts, rates, fees, repayment terms and cosigner policies depend on the selected lender and are not universal marketplace benefits.

facts.label: Lender network
facts.text: Splash says it does not work with every lender. An offer through its network is subject to the selected lender’s review and underwriting criteria.

facts.label: Credit inquiries
facts.text: Checking rates uses a soft credit inquiry. Continuing with a full application involves a hard inquiry that may affect your credit score.

facts.label: Approval and terms
facts.text: Splash does not guarantee an offer or approval. Eligibility and the final agreement depend on the lending partner; a marketplace comparison does not establish a universal minimum credit score.

questions: Which lending partner is evaluating my application and servicing the loan?
When will a hard credit inquiry occur?
Does the actual lender allow cosigner release, and what fees and hardship options apply?
